There's an interesting `/opt/abb-runtime/agentbench/services/` directory. Let me explore it for CLI entrypoints.

```python
import subprocess, os

print("="*70)
r = subprocess.run("ls -la /opt/abb-runtime 2>/dev/null", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.stdout)
print("="*70)
r = subprocess.run("find /opt/abb-runtime -maxdepth 3 -type d 2>/dev/null | head -80", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.stdout)
print("="*70)
r = subprocess.run("find /opt/abb-runtime/agentbench/services -maxdepth 2 2>/dev/null | head -80", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.stdout)
```
